scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @nexo/api" "npm run dev -w @nexo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexo/api && npm run build -w @nexo/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages script tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages script tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
